newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's Klima convinced Italy in EMU in 1999.
newsitem.headline: Austria's Klima convinced Italy in EMU in 1999.

text.p: Austrian Chancellor Viktor Klima said on Friday he was convinced Italy would meet the criteria to join Europe's single currency in 1999.

"I wish for economic as well as for neighbourly reasons that Italy will be part of the first group of EMU members, and I am convinced that Italy will meet the criteria," Klima told reporters after meeting Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi.
"I think it is an important political and economic signal that EMU will start in 1999," he added.
Italy is Austria's second biggest trading partner after Germany, accounting for some 20 percent of Austria's overall foreign trade.
